name: CinemaCity Download Lab
description: CinemaCity Download Lab 2.1.0. Fixes functionSlice, which dropped the entire body of any function taking a destructured object parameter (renderItems, buildName) because the inner brace of the parameter list closed the brace-depth loop at zero. Also raises the body cap from 5000 to 20000 chars so parseFileSet is no longer clipped, and marks truncated bodies explicitly instead of silently. Scraper id and manifest path stay stable so Nuvio keeps your saved Session Cookie.

scrapers.name: CinemaCity Download Lab v2.1.0
scrapers.description: DUI8BUILD=10.0.0. Dumps full download orchestration function bodies to logcat (grep CCDUMP) and as chunked DUI8B rows, with per-body brace-balance verification.
